name: family_flow_server
description: Backend API for the home affairs management application

scripts.db:sync: npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:migrate:test && npm run prisma:generate

scriptDescriptions.test: Run all tests sequentially using Jest.
scriptDescriptions.db:sync: Compile schemas, migrate both dev & test DBs, generate client, and link types for IDE.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:migrate:test: Apply generated migrations to the test database.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:studio: Open Prisma Studio UI for browsing/editing data.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:build: Compile Prisma schema from src/models into prisma/schema.prisma.
scriptDescriptions.prisma:migrate: Create/apply migrations in dev (runs prisma:build first).
scriptDescriptions.prisma:migrate:reset: Drop and recreate DB, then apply migrations (dev only).
scriptDescriptions.seed: Insert a reusable set of test users, family members, tasks, events, goals, and goal steps via services.

author: Alex Lev
